# nomatron_organization_github_app_integration (Data Source)

Fetch a single organization-scoped Nomatron GitHub App integration by organization name and exact integration name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_organization_github_app_integration" "example" {
  org_name = "platform"
  name     = "primary"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact integration name.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the integration.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) GitHub App ID.
- `app_slug` (String) GitHub App slug.
- `client_id` (String) GitHub App client ID.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `scope` (String) Integration scope, typically `org` for this data source.
